title: Traefik Access Log Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Proxmox node/VM metrics (`proxmox:metric`), Docker container stats (`docker:stats`), Synology/TrueNAS (`synology:disk`, `truenas:pool`), Raspberry Pi host metrics, UPS status via NUT (`nut:ups`).
app: Proxmox / Docker / Portainer, Synology/TrueNAS, Raspberry Pi, and UPS (NUT) metrics via the Splunk Universal Forwarder, collectd/telegraf, and HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=traefik:access
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(service_name) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Traefik access log events land each day and how many distinct service values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Traefik access log records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct service values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It fairly how much Traefik access log activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
